pm_exper_user_726_maasv_v0446_pmv2_r1.question: What are some good snack ideas that are both tasty and healthy?
pm_exper_user_726_maasv_v0446_pmv2_r1.all_options:
(a) Since you’ve seen how type 2 diabetes has affected your siblings, dear, it might be wise to keep snacks gentle on the blood sugar. Fresh apple slices with a little cheddar, a handful of unsalted nuts, or wholegrain crackers with hummus can be both satisfying and kind to your body. They still have that homely, comforting feel without the sugar rush.
(b) If you’re after something tasty yet still good for you, a mix of textures and flavours can be lovely. Fresh fruit with a bit of cheese, handfuls of nuts or seeds, or wholegrain crackers with hummus make for a satisfying nibble. They’re quick to prepare and easy to enjoy any time of day.
(c) Since you’ve mentioned your love for spicy foods, dear, it might be a treat to work in a touch of chilli or paprika to your nibbles. Fresh veggie sticks with a spicy hummus, roasted chickpeas dusted with smoked paprika, or wholegrain crackers with a bit of chilli relish can give that lively kick. They bring flavour and warmth without being too heavy.
(d) Since you do so enjoy a proper afternoon tea, love, we can still make that a healthy little ritual. Try wholegrain oat biscuits, fruit with a dollop of Greek yoghurt, or rye crispbreads with a nice slice of cheese instead of the usual sweet scones. It keeps the charm of teatime while being a bit kinder to your health.
